article.title: 更進新聞：Google在美國擴展Connected Apps零售結帳
article.title_en: Update: Google expands Connected Apps grocery checkout in the US
article.summary: Google宣布在美國Search及Gemini推出更多Connected Apps，涵蓋Albertsons、Safeway、Shaw’s及Target。
article.summary_en: Google is rolling out Connected Apps for Albertsons, Safeway, Shaw’s and Target through Search and Gemini in the US.
highlights: 新增零售應用以Universal Commerce Protocol支援建立訂單及結帳。
Angi及Thumbtack的帳戶連結仍列為未來數週推出。
highlights_en: The grocery apps use Universal Commerce Protocol for order building and checkout.
Angi and Thumbtack account linking remains planned for the coming weeks.
article.why: 商品探索至結帳可在助理入口銜接，零售團隊可評估哪些訂單資訊需要在對話內呈現，哪些仍需轉回商戶流程。
article.why_en: Retail teams can assess which order details belong in an assistant conversation and where a merchant handoff is still needed.
article.next_step: 以一組雜貨商品列出選品、購物籃及結帳的交接點，向支援商戶確認每一步可傳遞的資料。
article.next_step_en: Map product selection, basket and checkout handoffs for one grocery set, then confirm supported data with the merchant.
article.detail: 這次公告補充了具名零售商的美國接入，並非所有商戶都可加入。Universal Commerce Protocol是連接商務服務的協定。團隊可把訂單建立與付款確認分開檢視，再核對價格、供應及履約資訊的更新方式。對跨市場品牌而言，美國流程可作研究對象，其他市場的接入仍需另行確認。
article.detail_en: The update names US retailers rather than opening access to every merchant. Universal Commerce Protocol connects commerce services. Review order creation separately from payment confirmation, including updates to price, supply and fulfillment. Confirm other markets separately.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
article.followup: 10月29日版報道Connected Apps平台預覽；11月20日更新列出美國零售商的接入及結帳安排。
article.followup_en: Our October 29 issue covered the platform preview. The November 20 update names US retailers and their order and checkout access.
